上次整理 $__day__：那天没有可以整理的对话: Last run ($__day__): nothing to organize from that day
上次整理没成功：$__error__: The last run did not finish: $__error__
整理没跑成功，可以在日志里看到原因: The run did not finish — check the logs for the reason
记忆功能当前不可用，这次没有整理: Memory is currently unavailable, so nothing was organized
读不到本地数据，这次没有整理: Local data could not be read, so nothing was organized
还没有可用的模型 —— 先去「模型服务」里配一个: No model available yet — add one under “Model services” first
AI 会记住你告诉过它的事：偏好、项目约定、常用做法。开新对话时，相关的记忆会自: The AI remembers what you tell it — preferences, project conventions, habits. Related memories come along automatically in every new chat, so you do not have to repeat yourself.
点开可以逐条查看、改内容或删掉: Open it to view, edit or delete them one by one
每次对话自动带上的记忆条数: Number of memories brought along per chat
最多 $__max__ 条 —— 带得越多，占用的对话空间越多。: Up to $__max__ — more memories take up more of the conversation.
本次对话会带上 $__injected__ 条记忆（共 $__total__ 条: This chat brings along $__injected__ memories ($__total__ in total)
记忆有点多，这次没能全部带上：漏掉永久 $__permanent__ 条、普通: There are a lot of memories — not all fit: $__permanent__ permanent and $__normal__ normal ones were left out
「永久」每次都会全量带上，所以建议删掉用不到的，或把不常回顾的改成「普通」。: Permanent memories always come along in full, so delete the ones you no longer need, or switch rarely used ones to Normal.
AI 每次会读到的记忆内容: What the AI reads in every chat
（现在还没有会被带上的记忆）: (No memories will be brought along yet)
整理时，AI 会回顾那一天的对话，把值得长期记住的内容写成一条条记忆。同一天只会: When organizing, the AI reviews that day's chats and turns what is worth keeping into memories. Each day is organized once; long content is stored in the knowledge base, with only a summary left in the memory.
属于某个项目的记忆，只会在该项目里的对话中带上（当前按 $__path__ 判断: Project-specific memories only come along in chats inside that project (currently judged by $__path__)
还没设默认工作目录，所以「项目」类的记忆暂时不会被带上（可在「Agent」里设置: No default working folder is set, so project memories are not brought along yet (set one under “Agent”)
导出失败：读不到记忆数据: Export failed: could not read the memories
删除选中的 $__count__ 条记忆？存进知识库的长内容也会一起删掉，无法恢: Delete the selected $__count__ memories? Long content stored in the knowledge base is deleted too, and this cannot be undone.
点一行就能改内容；要停用或删除，先勾选，再用右边的批量操作。: Click a row to edit it; to disable or delete, select rows first and use the batch actions on the right.
还没有记忆 —— 你可以自己加一条，也可以在对话里直接告诉 AI 什么值得记住: No memories yet — add one yourself, or simply tell the AI in a chat what is worth remembering
例如：这个项目用 pnpm build 构建: e.g. this project builds with pnpm build
写短一点更好记：建议 $__hint__ 字以内，最多 $__max__ 字。: Shorter is easier to remember: $__hint__ characters or fewer, $__max__ at most.
只在这个项目里带上: Only bring it along in this project
留空 = 所有项目都带上: Leave empty = bring it along in every project
正在停下 —— 这一份处理完就收手，已经进来的文档不会回退: Stopping — it will stop after this file; documents already added are kept
跳过同名的「$__name__」: Skipped 「$__name__」 (the knowledge base already has this name)
这个文件超过 $__limit__ MB，没有读进来: This file is over $__limit__ MB — not read in
这个文件夹里没有能导入的内容（只收 PDF 和纯文本文件）: Nothing in this folder can be imported (only PDF and plain-text files are read)
这个文件夹里没有能导入的内容：$__notes__: Nothing in this folder can be imported: $__notes__
这个压缩包里没有能导入的内容：$__notes__: Nothing in this zip can be imported: $__notes__
